name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Young Faculty Research Fellowships
benefit:
***Nature of Support:***

  - **Research Fellowship:** ₹20,000/- per month, in addition to the regular salary  - **Research Contingency Grant:** ₹5,00,000/- per year for a maximum of 5 years  - The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized &amp; eligible academic and R&amp;D institution.
  - Research Contingency Grant can be used for minor equipmen
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen. 1. The applicant must have obtained PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. 1. The applicant must have a regular position in the institute and should be engaged in research. 1. The upper age limit for the fellowship is 40 years on the date of submission of application. 1. YFRF under Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme can be availed only once by a candidate in his/her career. 1. The applicant availing any other fellowship is not eligible to apply. 1. Proposals for allotment of YFRF are to be submitted through eligible institutions only. 1. Each institution in the proposal may submit up to three nominations for the award for each round of call for applications. ***Discontinuation of the Fellowship:*** 1. The performance of YFRF would be reviewed periodically as per the discretion of PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY. 1. A detailed performance assessment/review of award would be conducted annually and decision on continuation of YFRF would be taken accordingly. 1. If any fellow wishes to discontinue the fellowship, the institution should inform Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme immediately. One month's notice is to be given to DIC through the institution before the date of discontinuation. 1. The implementing institution should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the project or the date of resignation of the fellow. The institution will ensure the submission of work report and other requisite documents from YFRF awardee. 1. PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY reserves the right to hold/ stop/ terminate the Fellowship at any stage because of reasons including, but not limited to the following: - Appropriate progress is not being made. - The grant is not being utilized properly. - Violation/ Non-compliance of guidelines. - Any other reason, which is deemed appropriate by PhD Cell, DIC, MeitY.
